package internalapi

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

// GetLearningWorkspace returns the narrow S10 read-only projection. The
// feature check lives in the use case and precedes any repository access.
func (h *Handler) GetLearningWorkspace(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.LearningWorkspace == nil {
		writeLearningWorkspaceError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "learning_workspace_unavailable")
		return
	}
	result, err := h.LearningWorkspace.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"))
	if err != nil {
		switch {
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrFeatureDisabled):
			writeLearningWorkspaceError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "learning_workspace_disabled")
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
			writeLearningWorkspaceError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_student_id")
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrStateChanged):
			writeLearningWorkspaceError(w, http.StatusConflict, "learning_workspace_state_changed")
		default:
			writeLearningWorkspaceError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "learning_workspace_unavailable")
		}
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(result)
}

func writeLearningWorkspaceError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, code string) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"error": map[string]string{"code": code}})
}
